assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia, occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10).
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting.
The service was provided for these documented indications (diagnosis codes I47.1,I25.10).
The service corresponds to the diagnostic monitoring service (CPT 93229).
SilverBridge Advantage requires prior authorization for the diagnostic monitoring service (CPT 93229).
The denial under CO-197 states the required precertification was not obtained before services were rendered.
